_comment: An INDEPENDENT second source for the saturation line, with no CoolProp anywhere in it. Every other reference in this repo traces back to CoolProp; if CoolProp were wrong, nothing else would catch it. These points come from Wolfram's ThermodynamicData, which implements the IAPWS formulations directly.
source: Wolfram ThermodynamicData["Water", ...] via the Wolfram MCP connector

functions.water: LiquidVaporPhaseBoundary — saturation pressure over liquid water

precision_note: Water values are as Wolfram printed them at its default 6 significant figures (relative precision ~1e-6, which is ~20x finer than the 2e-4 bias they are used to measure). Ice values came back at full double precision.
